app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.d.source:
A hash describing the CSV fields on input. Keys are field names as given by the `header_names` or `headers` options (if neither is used, field names are numbers starting with `0`). Values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
- `timezone`: for `date` types only; passed to [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) to parse dates (overrides any default time zone; use when different columns have different time zones)

**Note**: setting this value also sets `headers` if not set automatically with `header_names`. If no field type is given, the default is `*string`. Invalid field names in this option are ignored.
app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.d.message:
Un hash che descrive i campi CSV in input. Le chiavi sono i nomi dei campi forniti dalle opzioni `header_names` o `headers` (se non viene utilizzata nessuna delle due, i nomi dei campi sono numeri che iniziano con `0`). I valori sono [tipi di campo](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) o un hash con le seguenti chiavi:
- `type`: una [stringa di tipo di campo](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: per i tipi `date`, un [formato data](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); per i tipi `int`, `float` o `number`, una stringa di formato numerico: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (es. `".,3"` = `.` migliaia, `,` decimale, 3 cifre decimali)
- `timezone`: solo per i tipi `date`; passato a [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) per analizzare le date (sovrascrive qualsiasi fuso orario predefinito; utilizzare quando colonne diverse hanno fusi orari diversi)

**Nota**: l'impostazione di questo valore imposta anche `headers` se non impostato automaticamente con `header_names`. Se non viene specificato alcun tipo di campo, il valore predefinito è `*string`. I nomi di campo non validi in questa opzione vengono ignorati.

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..source:
A hash describing the CSV fields to output. Keys are field names, values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..message:
Un hash che descrive i campi CSV da emettere. Le chiavi sono i nomi dei campi, i valori sono [tipi di campo](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) o un hash con le seguenti chiavi:
- `type`: una [stringa del tipo di campo](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: per i tipi `date`, un [formato data](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); per i tipi `int`, `float` o `number`, una stringa di formato numerico: *<separatore_migliaia>*[*<separatore_decimale>*[*<decimali>*]] (es. `".,3"` = `.` per le migliaia, `,` per i decimali, 3 cifre decimali)
